text: Physical therapist home program (Aug 2024 - Jun 2025): shoulder (serratus/scapular control, reverse wall push-up, eccentric biceps loading, half Turkish get-up), low back mobility (Mar 2025: trunk rotations, thread the needle, cat-camel, child pose traction) and neck/upper back (Aug 2024 and Jun 2025: scalene stretch, chin-tuck flys, prone T, W wall slides, neck nods). Built into upper/lower warm-ups and recovery-day mobility from Block 1; half TGU and eccentric biceps available as shoulder accessories.
